query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'ragtime-the-ruth-nathan-hale-theater',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Ragtime at The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for the Tony Award-winning musical Ragtime at The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater''s inaugural production.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/xnZpCwzGahkJyZsk.jpg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"Ragtime brought me to The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater to support Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for the inaugural production at this brand-new state-of-the-art venue in Pleasant Grove, Utah. This Tony Award-winning musical weaves together three families'' distinctly American stories united by courage, compassion, and a belief in the promise of the future."},{"type":"header","content":"The Production"},{"type":"text","content":"Directed by Jennifer Hill Barlow with music direction by Anne Puzey and choreography by Joshua Whitehead, Ragtime tells the story of early 20th-century America through the intertwined lives of an upper-class white family, a Jewish immigrant, and an African American pianist. The musical features a score by Stephen Flaherty and Lynn Ahrens with a book by Terrence McNally, based on E.L. Doctorow''s novel.\\n\\nJo Winiarski''s scenic design created a versatile environment that moved fluidly between New York tenements, suburban homes, and public spaces—capturing the social stratification and cultural collision of turn-of-the-century America. The design supported the musical''s epic scope while maintaining intimate moments essential to the characters'' emotional journeys.\\n\\nThe production ran from January 4 through February 22, 2025, marking a triumphant opening for The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater''s new home. Critics praised the production for its powerful storytelling and technical excellence in the venue''s Scott & Karen Smith Grand Theater."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/xnZpCwzGahkJyZsk.jpg","caption":"Ragtime at The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater, 2025. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. The inaugural production in the new state-of-the-art venue. Photo courtesy The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater."},{"type":"header","content":"The Creative Team"},{"type":"team","title":"The Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Terrence McNally","role":"Book"},{"name":"Stephen Flaherty","role":"Music"},{"name":"Lynn Ahrens","role":"Lyrics"},{"name":"Jennifer Hill Barlow","role":"Director"},{"name":"Anne Puzey","role":"Music Director"},{"name":"Joshua Whitehead","role":"Choreographer"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Ryan Fallis","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Dan Morgan","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Cole McClure","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Dennis Wright","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Bekah Wilbur","role":"Hair & Makeup Designer"},{"name":"Ben Henderson","role":"Fight Director"}]},{"type":"header","content":"About The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater"},{"type":"text","content":"The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater at doTERRA represents a new chapter for the former Hale Center Theater Orem. This state-of-the-art facility features two performance venues and continues the legacy of Ruth and Nathan Hale, pioneers in community theater who lit the stage with their passion for storytelling and commitment to family-friendly productions."},{"type":"link","url":"https://www.theruth.org","label":"Visit The Ruth and Nathan Hale Theater"}]',
  90002,
  '2025-02-22',
  '2025-02-22',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
